Type: lamp
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Contemporary Flush-Mount Ceiling Light withBulb and Glass Shade - 14 x 14 x 7.25 Inches, Oil-Rubbed Bronze
Colors: Oil-rubbed Bronze
Materials: Alloy Steel
This semiflush ceiling light brings sleek contemporary style to any space. The painted steel mount features elegant curved rods, supporting a clear glass ring to amplify the clean, light from within. 14"W x 14"D x 7.25"H Painted steel light, clear glass Semiflush light, mid-century meets contemporary style Bulb included Professional installation recommended For indoor use only
